summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed on the public portfolio at desktop and mobile widths.

integration_issues.flow: Project row expansion and case study
integration_issues.issue: The first click on a project row simultaneously expands its description and opens the case-study overlay. Requested behavior is first click expands description, second click opens case study.

action_items: Separate expandedProject state from active case-study state so project row clicks require two clicks for case-study opening.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js uses one activeProject state for both row expansion and overlay visibility, causing the interaction mismatch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested. Hero, View my work CTA, four project rows, case overlay close, mobile viewport width (390px document width), and no page error messages were checked. Mobile menu opened; the follow-up assertion incorrectly required the hidden nav node to be removed rather than hidden, so mobile navigation close was not scored as an app failure.
rca of the issue: In App.js project row onClick toggles activeProject. The same activeProject !== null condition renders case-study-overlay, while activeProject === i also drives the active/description class. Therefore the first click necessarily opens both states. Use separate expandedProject and caseStudyProject state, with first click setting expandedProject and second click setting caseStudyProject. No APIs were mocked; backend intentionally skipped.
